filed_rule.statement: Let gap_share, gap_pooled, gap_perkey be the mean over the three copy seeds minus the mean over the three lookup seeds, each in log-odds on the score windows; steering's gap = the wider of gap_pooled and gap_perkey. edge = gap_share - steering's gap.
filed_rule.rival_a: edge >= 0.1: rival A, the share keeps an edge on this pair.
filed_rule.rival_b: edge < 0.1 (including below 0): rival B, no edge.
filed_rule.unreadable: Unreadable: any state whose log-odds gain on the score windows is below MIN_GAIN (1 log-odds), or any nan among the six.
filed_rule.inert: Inert steering: if steering's copy and lookup shares are all below 0.05, in both kinds, the verdict is "no call: steering inert", not rival A. A vector that writes nothing would otherwise make the share look as if it has an edge. Filed because the do-nothing case (zero vector, gap 0) passes edge >= 0.1 on its own.
filed_rule.edge_cases: ties at exactly 0.1 go to rival A; steering's gap above the share's gives a negative edge, rival B; one seed's nan is unreadable, not dropped; an empty fit-half key cannot occur (checked above, all 32 keys have a fit window, and the job stops if not).
filed_rule.reading_of_wider: 'the wider of gap_pooled and gap_perkey' is the larger signed value (max), the copy-minus-lookup gap that separates copy above lookup more; the gaps are signed copy minus lookup (the code's verdict rule).
filed_rule.precedence: unreadable first, then inert (no call, whatever the edge), then rival A or B.

selection: Each state and vector kind gets its own (layer, strength), chosen by the largest fit-half mean log-odds rise, ties to the lower layer then the lower strength. Layers 0 to 3 at sites in<l>, strengths {0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8}. Even-indexed read windows are the fit half, odd-indexed the score half. A nan among the grid's rises leaves the setting undefined and the kind's shares nan.

stage_0_stops.a: a zero update through the full steering path reads rise exactly 0 for both vector kinds (stop if any |rise| > 1e-9)
stage_0_stops.b: strength 0 on copy_s0 reads exactly 0 (same stop)
stage_0_stops.c: the share of each of the six states on all 200 windows reproduces experiments/induction_cue/results/run.json .states.<state>.r within 0.01, a tenth of the card's smallest gap (stop on a miss)

expected.steering_share_log_odds_pooled: copy 0.7 to 0.9, lookup 0.1 to 0.3 (E58's copy and lookup, reports/analyses/2026-11-09_analysis_what-regating-does_appendix.md)
expected.gap_share: about 0.69 on the 200 windows (1.09 to 1.10 against 0.38 to 0.42); on the 100 score windows it may move by a few hundredths.
expected.zero_update: The share of a zero update is undefined; do-nothing reads the share by construction (E125's check).
expected.random: Random vectors' mean share within 0.1 of 0 on each side (a miss is reported and marks the reading, it does not stop the job).

metric_blind_to: The steering share is blind to whether the vector does it through the fine-tune's own route; the gap is blind to levels (both sides could move together).
positive_control: The zero update and strength 0 at stage 0, and the reproduction of r.
noise_floor: Seed sd of each side, reported; the card's spread (0.042) is from the log P share on other rows, since steering has never been read at this marker.
